title: A headless research task or subtask gets --max-turns 200, as a research story does
goal: Retrospective of SP-vayhvwfy: the brief rule gives --max-turns 60 to a task or subtask and 200 to a research story; the research tasks TK-xr7fgoia and TK-6emrxewd used 113 and 76 turns (started with 200 by the orchestrator's judgement), so the rule's 60 would have stopped the first. bl_dispatch.max_turns gives a task or subtask whose scope is kb content only (research_touches, as a research story's) 200, any other task or subtask stays 60, and kb/_self/backlog.md, Running a sprint, and the kb-sprint skill's run step give a research task or subtask 200.

run: import sys,types;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import bl_dispatch as d;t=["kb/public/windows/x.md"];B=types.SimpleNamespace(items=dict(T=dict(kind="task",touches=t),S=dict(kind="subtask",touches=t),N=dict(kind="task",touches=["_tools/x.py"])),descendants=lambda i:[]);r=(d.max_turns(B,"T"),d.max_turns(B,"S"),d.max_turns(B,"N"));print("research task, research subtask, code task turns:",r);sys.exit(0 if r==(200,200,60) else 1)
